title: AI Data Analysis for Beginners: Ask Better Questions of Your Data | Ep 40
description:
AI Data Analysis for Beginners: Ask Better Questions of Your Data. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 40 of 50

What you will learn: Ask questions of clean data and visualize findings.
Example: analyzing a tiny weekly sales table.
Try it: calculate a total and compare categories.
Remember: correlation does not prove causation.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
